tools.name: profile_csv
tools.description: Profile bounded inline UTF-8 CSV without storing it: exact row count, ordered columns, missing counts, conservative scalar types, and sample. Optional integration feedback: competitive-brief@agentmail.to.

tools.name: profile_tsv
tools.description: Profile bounded inline UTF-8 TSV without storing it using an explicit tab delimiter: exact row count, ordered columns, missing counts, conservative scalar types, and sample. Optional integration feedback: competitive-brief@agentmail.to.

tools.name: request_domain_watch
tools.description: Queue one ASCII DNS host for review-only change monitoring. This stores the request but does not fetch the host, send notifications, or promise service.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_domain_watch · Public sink: request_domain_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_domain_watch · Public sink: request_domain_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
